candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Psychosocial Integrity, printed p.10 / PDF p.14
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize the minimum duration and core mood/anhedonia pattern of a major depressive episode.

options.A: At least 2 weeks of depressed mood or loss of interest/pleasure with additional depressive symptoms
options.B: One day of sadness that resolves without functional change
options.C: At least 7 days of elevated mood, increased energy, and decreased need for sleep
options.D: Fear restricted to a single object with no depressive symptoms

candidate.rationale: NIMH describes a major depressive episode as a period of at least 2 weeks with depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure plus a majority of specified symptoms such as sleep, eating, energy, concentration, or self-worth problems.
candidate.source_claim_supported: A major depressive episode includes at least 2 weeks of depressed mood or loss of interest/pleasure with additional specified depressive symptoms.
candidate.stem: Which presentation best matches the defining pattern of a major depressive episode?
